# Subway Seat for Ghostty

The 16 ANSI colors, cursor, selection, search matches, split divider and unfocused-split fill. Ghostty 1.2 reports the search keys as unknown but applies the rest.

[Ghostty](https://ghostty.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/ghostty/) · Needs Ghostty 1.3+

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = Subway Seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = Subway Seat Tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = Subway Seat Enamel
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = London Moquette
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = London Deep Level
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = London Portland
```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = Paris Guimard
```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = Paris Catacombes
```

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = Paris Carrelage
```

## Follow light and dark

In ~/.config/ghostty/config (or config.ghostty):

```conf
theme = light:Subway Seat Enamel,dark:Subway Seat
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Subway Seat`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Subway Seat Tunnel`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Subway Seat Enamel`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/London Moquette`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/London Deep Level`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/London Portland`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Paris Guimard`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Paris Catacombes`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Paris Carrelage`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
